title: 第15章  F2357空间点第16章  钢鬃象
slug: 从龙象般若功开始创武成圣
content_zh:
大屿镇外。
全副武装的守备队员，检查了苏青的证件，又抬眸看了苏青一眼。
“例行公事，我问你答，来F2357空间点做什么？”
“报告长官，带武徒协助城区防务，并进行武道研究！”
“知道F2357空间点特性吗？”
“报告长官，知道，其白天是大屿镇，夜晚是猛兽岭，白天不安全，因为会有妖兽过来袭扰，夜晚更危险，天地环境巨变，妖兽数量更多。”
“知道在空间点做事的规矩吗？”
“报告长官，知道，风险自担，安全自理！”
刘有财好笑的看着苏青：“像你这么年轻的创武师，还能亲自来刷资源，很难得了。”
“报告长官，参加防务工作，武者人人有责，不是刷资源呢。”苏青道。
“记录仪都关了，你跟我装什么呢！”
“一片赤胆，怎可言装？”
“行了，行了，进去吧，最近空间异动，一旦发现不对，就趁早出来。”
“那你们能进来吗，我说我们遇到大货，哦不，是危险的时候，能劳烦你们帮忙搭把手？”
“原则上不行。”
“原则值多少钱？”
“三成战利品，我等就可在不影响正常工作的情况下，援手卫国保民之义士，联邦创武之英才。”
“怎么联系你们？”
“燃烧棒，三万一根。”
“这东西我们带了啊！”

“自带的不行。”
“烧不起来？”
“是烧起来我们不认。”
花了三万块，买了根护身符。
在进入大屿镇的路上，苏青一直在腹诽联邦贪污受贿盛行的不正之风。
“他们也不容易吧，坚守空间点，每时每刻都要接受亚空间的精神污染。”
傅佳佳开口，帮守备队员们说了句好话。
苏青点头又摇头：“这种污染，其实是能锤炼武道意志，提升精神力的，有武者还主动来求锤呢，
不过他们也的确不容易，空间点一旦异动，他们首当其冲，随时有殒命风险。”
他动了心思，心道在空间点修行铁布衫或许是个不错的选择。
出去后可以跟守备队员们推销下！
所创武学引用量跟修行量，可直接关乎一个创武师的声誉的。
他苏青虽然刚入行，但铁布衫上传两三天了，才有一两个人订阅修行。
这就很没面子，需要他想想办法。
“一小队守备军，就能守住一个空间点吗，不怕里面的异类冲出来？”杨铁牛有些担心道。
“只是F级空间点而已，无论是我们人武界还是万妖界，都只有F级存在能进入。
这些孱弱妖兽，只要定期清理不让它们形成兽潮，一小队守备队员足够了！”
苏青说着话，眼睛一直在观察周围环境。
现在还是白天，这方空间属于他们人武界（亚空间异类对天蓝星的称呼）。
属于大屿镇原先的风貌还隐约可见。

被巨物践踏过的石板路，断断续续，在山野田林间错落的屋舍，都变成了废墟一堆。
在全镇搬迁之后，少了人类的干预，草木野蛮生长，路边随处可见妖兽粪便。
青草香气，粪便异味，混杂在一处，一股名为自然的味道油然而生。
content_en:
Outside Lantau Town.
The heavily armed guards checked Su Qing's ID and then raised their eyes to look at Su Qing.
"As a matter of routine, let me ask you, what are you doing in space point F2357?"
"Report to the commander, lead martial arts disciples to assist in city defense and conduct martial arts research!"
"Do you know the characteristics of F2357 space point?"
"Sir, I know that it is Lantau Town during the day and Beast Ridge at night. It is not safe during the day because there will be monsters coming to harass you. It is even more dangerous at night because the environment of the world changes drastically and there are more monsters."
"Do you know the rules for doing things in space?"
"Sir, I know, take care of your own risk and take care of your own safety!"
Liu Youcai looked at Su Qing amusedly: "It's rare for a creative martial artist as young as you to be able to brush resources in person."
"Sir, everyone is responsible for participating in defense work. We are not just trying to use resources." Su Qing said.
"The recorder is turned off, what are you pretending to me?"
"How can you pretend to be brave?"
"Okay, okay, let's go in. There have been changes in space recently. If you find something wrong, come out as soon as possible."
"Then can you come in? I said we encountered a big cargo, oh no, it's a dangerous time. Can I ask you to help me?"
"Not in principle."
“How much are principles worth?”
"With 30% of the loot, we can help the martyrs who defend the country and the people and the talents of the Federation without affecting our normal work."
"How can I contact you?"
"Thirty thousand burning rods."
"We brought this thing!"
"Bringing your own won't do."
"Can't you burn it?"
"We don't recognize it when it's burned."
I spent 30,000 yuan to buy a root amulet.
On the way into Lantau Town, Su Qing had been criticizing the prevalence of corruption and bribery in the federation.
"It's not easy for them either. They stick to the space point and have to accept the mental pollution of the subspace every moment."
Fu Jiajia opened her mouth and said a good word to the defensive team members.
Su Qing nodded and shook his head: "This kind of pollution can actually temper the will of martial arts and improve mental strength. Some warriors even take the initiative to ask for a hammer.
But it is indeed not easy for them. Once the space point changes, they will bear the brunt and risk death at any time. "
He thought about it and thought that it might be a good choice to practice Iron Cloth Shirt at a point in space.
After you go out, you can sell it to the field members!
The amount of martial arts references and practice can be directly related to the reputation of a martial arts master.
Although he, Su Qing, had just entered the industry, it had been two or three days since Tiebushan had been uploaded, and only one or two people had subscribed to practice.
This is very shameless and requires him to think of a solution.
"Can a small group of garrison troops guard a point in space without fear of the aliens inside rushing out?" Yang Tieniu asked worriedly.
"It's just an F-level space point. Whether it's our human martial arts world or the world of monsters, only F-level beings can enter it.
As long as these weak monsters are cleaned up regularly to prevent them from forming a beast tide, a small team of defenders is enough! "
As Su Qing spoke, her eyes were constantly observing the surrounding environment.
It's still daytime, and this space belongs to their human martial world (the subspace aliens' name for Sky Blue Star).
The original features of Lantau Town are still vaguely visible.
The stone roads trampled by giant objects were intermittent, and the houses scattered among the mountains, fields and forests were turned into piles of ruins.
After the town was relocated, without human intervention, vegetation grew wildly, and monster feces could be seen everywhere on the roadside.
The aroma of green grass and the odor of feces are mixed together, and a smell called nature arises spontaneously.
